questions.question: In the catalog item extras (CatalogExtras), what do the labels 'Cover', 'Lead' and 'Drop' mean? They appear as a tag, a column label and a badge next to a product name with no other context. Current German guesses: Cover = cover image ('Titelbild'), Lead = lead/delivery time ('Lieferzeit'), Drop = new product release ('Neuheit'). questions.answer: Cover is a protective phone case (an accessory). Lead is the lead time until the item ships. Drop means a price drop: the item was just reduced.
